# ethereum-optimism/op-geth Daily Update (Jan 28, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today, a new pull request was opened to explore an opgas proof-of-concept. Discussions continued on several active issues, including the `SyncStatus` API for `op-supernode` and the handling of EIP-1559 parameters. Two issues related to resource locators and OPCM v2 checks were closed.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new pull request, [#758](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/758), titled "opgas PoC," was opened to explore a proof-of-concept for opgas.

## CLOSED ISSUES

**Cleanup of Obsolete Development Tasks**
- The issue to remove checks for the use of OPCM v2 to enable CGT, [#18536](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18536), was closed as the CGT PR has been merged and related checks removed.
- The issue to add a Resource Locator for v7_0_0 artifacts, [#18633](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18633), was closed as it belonged to a work in progress and the referenced file was later deleted.

## NEW ISSUES

**EIP-1559 Parameter Handling**
- A new issue, [#757](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/757), was created to address a potential division-by-zero panic in `CalcBaseFee` when elasticity is 0 due to invalid extraData.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

**Enhancing `op-supernode` SyncStatus API**
- Discussions on [#18947](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18947) regarding the `op-supernode` SyncStatus API continued. The latest comments suggest the interface should include the `op-node` SyncStatus for every chain, the sync status of every verification activity, and for interop activity, the latest verified timestamp and the current L1. It was also suggested that SyncStatus should report on the latest verified L2 to simplify acceptance testing.

**Addressing EIP-1559 Parameter Decoding**
- On [#18951](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18951), the focus is on fixing EIP-1559 parameters decoding in `op-alloy` to properly catch zero elasticities early. A community member expressed interest in taking on this task.

**Proving Withdrawals with Chain-Specific Root Claims**
- The discussion on [#18517](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18517) regarding proving withdrawals using chain-specific root claims saw an update. It was decided to move this to the backlog, as updating `OptimismPortal2` depends on the U19 execution and must be done separately from the FaultDisputeGame upgrade to ensure continuous withdrawal functionality.
